configurePresets.name: clang-release
configurePresets.description: LLVM clang++ (default install path), Release. Generator is Unix Makefiles, not Ninja: CMake's Ninja generator wires every Clang translation unit through a transient '@file.modmap' response file (its C++20 module-dependency machinery, unconditional for Clang regardless of CXX_SCAN_FOR_MODULES) that Ninja generates fresh during a real build but that clang-tidy -p (reading compile_commands.json and invoking the compiler directly, outside Ninja's build graph) can never find, so tidy always failed with 'no such file or directory'. Make-family generators have no such C++20-modules wiring in CMake at all, so the same compile_commands.json works for both building and tidying. Exports compile_commands.json for gate step 4.

configurePresets.name: gcc-release
configurePresets.description: g++ on PATH, Ninja, Release. No MinGW/gcc is installed on the reference machine, so this preset fails configure with one clear line naming g++ as the missing compiler; it is here for machines that do have it. Uses vcpkg's x64-mingw-dynamic triplet, not base's x64-windows: that triplet builds dependencies (gtest) with MSVC's ABI, which g++-compiled objects cannot link against.
